system.description:
Heroes. Champions. Legends! Their examples inspire us to greatness.

LEVEL 3

Recite Legend. Reaction (when you attack or cast a spell): Expend a Songweaver's Inspiration to invoke one of the following Legends on a target within Range 6.

  • Legend of Will. Grant WIL×2 Temp HP.
  • Legend of Might. Push WIL spaces and knock Prone.
  • Legend of Snark. Deal WIL×2 psychic damage (ignoring armor).
  • Legend of Tragedy. Inflict Slowed and Poisoned for one turn.

LEVEL 7

Battle Ballad. When you Recite Legend, you and all allies within 12 spaces who can hear you gain advantage on their next attack.

LEVEL 11

Solo. (1/Safe Rest) Action: Embody the spirit of a legendary hero. Gain LVL+WIL Temp HP. Your attacks deal +WIL psychic damage (ignoring armor). You may Recite Legend without spending Songweaver's Inspiration. Solo ends if you have no Temp HP.

LEVEL 15

Finale. (1/encounter) 2 actions: Sacrifice all non-Temp HP. Deal LVL psychic damage (ignoring armor) to all enemies within 12 spaces who can hear you, then recite all four Legends.
